verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bitbucket/Rovo has AI features (docs-5) and Atlassian even publishes its own MCP server (bitbucket-probe-4), but that is Bitbucket acting as an MCP server/tool provider, not as a client that can plug in and use external MCP servers' tools. No evidence describes Bitbucket or Rovo consuming/connecting to third-party MCP servers.
